sources.scope: General hotel Useful Information; not original rate-plan checkout conditions
General service and optional recreation charges; not dated availability or an operating guarantee

currency.basis: US Orlando property and dollar amounts; editorial interpretation, no conversion

parking.limitation: Overnight section does not explicitly say per night in the inspected current text. Do not multiply by five or renew the older per-night interpretation.

extra_adult_charge.trigger: More than two adult guests per room

standard_cancellation.six_or_more_days_before_arrival: Full refund in the general policy
standard_cancellation.zero_to_five_days_before_arrival: One room night plus tax in the general policy
standard_cancellation.limitation: Do not overwrite original plan-specific unknown deposit/cancellation terms or infer Flexible Rate refundability.

parcel_handling.unit: per received package through Luggage Service

optional_services.limitation: Optional services are not assumed family selections, room inclusions, or confirmed November operations. No linked rental PDF, reservation or vendor contact opened.

unresolved_budget.basis: No explicit answers in these inspected sections. Absence is not a zero fee, free meals, or refundable rate.

retained_quote.task_basis: One suite, two adults and four count-only children; requested ages4/8/12/15 not individually confirmed; November8-13,2026, five nights
retained_quote.price_use: Preserve original separate nightly pre-tax/with-displayed-tax plans and room-tax stay totals, interpreted USD and all unknown extras. No price, party, terms or source-date rewrite.
